To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

male clients of female sex workers are older and more likely to be of a non-English speaking back ground, have more sexual partners but use condoms more frequently than men who deny ever having paid for sex.
male clients of FCSWs are more likely to be older and have more partners than non-commercially sexually active men.

clients of FCSWs are older, more likely married and have more sexual partners than controls but are more likely to use condoms, are more likely to report past STIs but have lower prevalence of STIs at clinic presentation than controls.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the health needs of a population of male clients of female sex workers, and the health implications of their sexual behaviour for the community.
the sexual health of men who use the services of female commercial sex-workers.
the sexual health of male clients of FCSWs.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the clients are a high risk group, but not as risky as previously thought, and the controls are a low risk group.
male clients of FCSWs are at increased risk of STIs, but that the majority of clients do not have STIs at the time of their visit to a sexual health clinic, and the risk of HIV is low.
male clients of FCSWs have more sexual partners than controls but report higher condom usage, are more likely to have a history of STIs and have similar HIV prevalence.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
clients of commercial sex are a group of men with different risk characteristics to other men.
male clients of commercial sex work are a group with high-risk behaviours but low rates of STIs.
male clients of female sex workers are a heterogeneous group with some characteristics of high risk sexual behaviours but low prevalence of STIs.
The main takeaway from our work is that
male clients of female FSW are not a high-risk group for HIV and STIs.
clients of FCSW are a high risk population with significant STIs and risk behaviours.
male clients of FCSWs in Sydney are a heterogeneous group.
